cases.disease: Hereditary angioedema due to C1-inhibitor deficiency
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~3.6-kb SVA in SERPING1 intron 7 (OGM estimate 3.8 kb) segregates with HAE in a three-generation family; phasing with a coding SNP showed the SVA-bearing allele is absent from cDNA (monoallelic expression), consistent with NMD of aberrant transcripts and functional haploinsufficiency.
cases.quote: Finally, we demonstrated that the allele carrying the SVA insertion was absent in cDNA resulting in SERPING1 functional haploinsufficiency in this family.
